evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage items (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) each with image, category tag, title, English name, region and description.
Clicking '了解详情' link on 春节 card navigated to /heritage/spring-festival dedicated detail page.
Detail page for 春节 and 京剧 show title, English name, category, region, inscription year, full description paragraph, and multiple browsable thumbnail images.
Category filter dropdown offers 传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术; selecting 传统工艺 correctly filtered list to 苏绣 and 宜兴紫砂 (2 of 8 items).
Every item card in the list displays exactly one category badge (e.g. 民俗活动, 传统美术, 传统表演, 传统工艺) confirming categorization.
All 8 cards include title (Chinese+English), region, and description text; detail pages additionally show inscription year.

Opened 苏绣 hotspot overlay in panorama, navigated to its detail page via '查看详情', then browser-back restored the panorama scene AND re-opened the 苏绣 overlay exactly as before. Separately, zooming the panorama (scale 1→1.2) then clicking the 京剧 hotspot opened its overlay while zoom scale remained 1.2, confirming operational state persists across actions.

Panorama page displayed incremental loading prompt '正在加载热点... (3/8)' / '(4/8)' while hotspots were still loading. The 春节 detail page displayed '图片加载失败' (image failed to load) prompt for a broken main image before a thumbnail was selected.

Clicking valid project links navigates to their detail pages (e.g. /heritage/spring-festival). Navigating directly to an invalid slug /heritage/nonexistent-item shows '未找到该非遗项目' (item not found) with a return-home link instead of rendering a detail page.

List view uses a grid of cards with thumbnail/category badge/title/short description; detail view uses a distinct hero layout with breadcrumb navigation, large image gallery, full description and 'back to panorama/browse more' actions — clearly distinguishable states.

All 8 items are genuine well-known Chinese ICH entries (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) with plausible regions and UNESCO/national inscription years (e.g. 京剧 2010年入选, 春节 2006年入选) consistent with real historical records.
